newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean export inspections hit record --USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean export inspections hit record --USDA.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Monday said U.S. soybean export inspections in the week ended November 14 of 38.924 million bushels were a record high.
USDA began keeping records on export inspections in 1983.

USDA said the soybean export inspections total broke the prior week's record of 33.4 million bushels. The total for that week, ending Nov. 7, was revised up sharply to 37 million bushels in today's report.
Weekly soybean export inspections have only topped the 30 million bushel mark about a dozen times since the department began keeping records, a USDA official said.
CBOT soybean futures rose sharply on the stronger-than-expected soybean export inspections. Trade forecasts had ranged from 25 to 30 million bushels.
